Measure I2C rise time and power/noise/cold behavior on assembled pilots; nominal RC screening is not a bus measurement.
Verify GNSS/antenna performance with green solder mask and real panel/string assembly.

For future U6 population, apply MSL/stencil handling, clean aperture and high-impedance reference region, and verify all tented annuli.
